options.content: Entry: ops/runbooks/operations_runbook.md, healthy infrastructure/stale release section. Compare fresh cache-miss traces with deploy events: active_bundle_id versus registry_revision and cache_namespace, plus producing prompt/model/index versions. Offline: ops/drills/golden_dataset_eval.sh; evidence: tmp/stale-release/traces.jsonl, deploy.jsonl and golden-result.json. HTTP 200 and green liveness are not semantic readiness. Resync the current intended pointer; bounded tenant cache bypass must not change provider safety circuits. This panel documents synthetic evidence locations; it provisions no exporter, live probe, alert delivery or production authorization.

Entry: ops/runbooks/operations_runbook.md. Offline: bash ops/drills/simulate_latency_alert.sh, then inspect/restart/verify with labs/production-operations/worker_recovery.rb. QueueAgeHigh requires oldest pending age >= 2 s and unchanged completion count across samples one second apart. Compare queue wait with provider spans; long provider time is not a worker-stall diagnosis. Reports: tmp/anchor-operations/actions.jsonl and recovery.json, including original backlog p95, fresh-window p95, sample count and recovery elapsed time. Rails emits anchor.ticket_worker notifications with job_id, queue and queue_wait_ms; connect a deployment subscriber to existing trace context and retrieval/tool/LLM spans. No notification exporter, SQL queue datasource, alert delivery or production SLO is provisioned by this panel. Missing telemetry is unknown, not healthy. Check cache hit rate and recent changes if queue/provider evidence does not explain latency.

panels.title: AI incidents — severity and human-banner deadline

options.content: Use ops/runbooks/ai_incidents.md. AiOperatingMode.audit records incident_declared events with incident_id, severity, alert routes, detected_at, and human_banner_deadline. The operator change audit records actor_id, reason, and activation time. SEV1 requires the same ticket's human handoff within 60 seconds of detection. Offline preview: bash ops/drills/simulate_cost_spike.sh chat. var/incident_playbook/banner.json records the measured service handoff; it is not deployed HTTP or worker-cancellation evidence. This panel documents evidence sources and does not fabricate a telemetry series or deliver pages.

Offline evidence: ops/load/benchmark_report.md, generated by ops/load/ticket_spike.py. Compare successful p50/p95/p99, worker queue p99, model-call time, timeout and provider_429 counts, useful throughput, tenant admission outcomes, and batch scheduler wait. These are report fields, not deployed Prometheus series. Production diagnosis also requires actual inference queue/token metrics and correlated Rails traces. Offline reports do not certify production capacity.
